name: Laravel 12 Queue Management
description: Queue job creation and management workflow for Laravel 12

steps.content:
🔄 Laravel 12 Queue Job Management:

✅ Implement ShouldQueue interface
✅ Add proper error handling
✅ Use job middleware for rate limiting
✅ Implement proper retry logic
✅ Add job batching if needed
✅ Monitor queue workers
✅ Use unique jobs to prevent duplicates
✅ Implement proper logging
